The following is the description of this work on DLsite：

表向きは貞淑な妻、母、そして憧れの先生。けれど裏では、団地中の男たちに身体を差し出す「公共肉便器」として悦びに溺れる三人。団地一の金持ち夫人として優雅に振る舞う佐藤恵(24歳)、三児を育てる豊満ぽっちゃりママの高橋澪(40歳)、学生たちの憧れの的である保健室の中村綾香(37歳)――それぞれ全く異なる魅力を持つ人妻たちが、夫の前では見せない本当の顔を晒していくCG集です。

前半は、愛する夫との濃密な子作りSEX。健気に腰を振り、子種をねだる甘く慎ましやかな夫婦の営みが描かれます。誰もが羨む幸せな夫婦の姿――しかしそれは、彼女たちの持つ二つの顔のうちの一つに過ぎなかった。

後半、舞台が変わると共に三人の本性が顔をだす。金持ち夫人・恵は団地の男たちに群がられる人気肉便器として、ぽっちゃりママ・澪はその豊満な肉体で複数の男を受け止める肉便器として、そして保健の先生・綾香は普段接している生徒を優しく搾り尽くすショタ専用肉便器として――それぞれの性癖を全開に、惜しげもなく肉体を差し出していきます。

本作の見どころは、対照的な「表の顔」と「裏の顔」の鮮烈な落差。愛する夫を見つめる優しい瞳と、見知らぬ男たちに犯されながら蕩けていく淫らな表情。そのギャップが、一枚一枚のCGに濃密な背徳感を刻み込みます。三人三様の肉便器人生、その淫蕩な性事情を余すところなくお届けします。

On the surface, they are virtuous wives, mothers and the teachers everyone admires. Yet behind closed doors, the three women revel in pleasure as ‘public sex objects’, offering their bodies to every man in the housing estate. Megumi Sato (24), who conducts herself with elegance as the wealthiest lady in the housing estate; Mio Takahashi (40), a voluptuous, curvy mum raising three children; and Ayaka Nakamura (37), the school nurse who is the object of her students’ admiration—this CG collection reveals the true faces of these married women, each possessing a completely different charm, that they never show in front of their husbands.

The first half depicts intense, child-making sex with their beloved husbands. It portrays the sweet, demure marital intimacy of a couple, as she earnestly sways her hips, begging for his seed. The image of a happy couple that everyone envies—yet this was merely one of their two faces.

In the second half, as the setting changes, the true nature of the three women comes to the fore. Megumi, the wealthy housewife, becomes a popular sex object swarmed by men in the housing estate; Mio, the curvy mum, becomes a sex object who takes on multiple men with her voluptuous body; and Ayaka, the school nurse, becomes a sex object dedicated to young boys, gently milking the pupils she normally interacts with—each unleashing their sexual preferences to the full and offering up their bodies without reservation.

The highlight of this work is the striking contrast between their ‘public faces’ and their ‘hidden faces’. The gentle gaze they cast upon their beloved husbands stands in stark contrast to the lewd expressions they wear as they melt with pleasure whilst being violated by strangers. This gap imbues every single CG image with an intense sense of transgression. We present, in its entirety, the lewd sexual lives of these three women, each leading their own distinct existence as sex slaves.
